title: Minnesota DANCO Violations Explained
description: A DANCO, or Domestic Abuse No Contact Order, is a criminal court order in Minnesota that can restrict contact while a case is pending. In this video, criminal defense attorney Andrew Davis explains how DANCO violations work, including what happens if the protected person contacts first, why third-party messages can still create problems, what evidence may be used to prove contact, and what someone should do if they are accused of violating a DANCO.

title: Drug Charges in Minnesota: What You Need to Know
description: Drug charges in Minnesota can turn on details that are easy to overlook. In this video, criminal defense attorney Andrew Davis explains the difference between possession and sale allegations and why he looks closely at where drugs were found, who owned or controlled the area, whether a car or apartment was shared, what statements were made, and how police obtained the evidence. He also discusses how quantity and alleged intent may affect a case, why shared spaces do not automatically answer who possessed the drugs, and why clients should preserve messages, voicemails, and other details that may help explain what happened.

title: Minnesota THC & Cannabis Laws: Legal Doesn’t Mean Unlimited
description: Cannabis is legal for adults in Minnesota, but legal does not mean unlimited. In this video, Minnesota criminal defense attorney Andrew Davis explains why the amount, form, location, packaging, age of the person involved, and whether someone was driving can all matter. He discusses Minnesota's adult possession limits, cannabis in a vehicle, alleged impairment, and why legally purchasing marijuana does not automatically eliminate the possibility of criminal charges. Andrew also explains why people questioned by law enforcement should exercise their right to remain silent and speak with a criminal defense attorney before answering questions.
